agency migration service guide

Quick thread 🧵
> As a repeatable service, not a one-off scramble.

There are two shapes: onboarding migration, moving a single new client in, usually offered free because it removes the biggest reason not to switch to you; and portfolio migration, moving a whole book of sites onto one managed account, which you can run as a paid project or…
Run both the same disciplined way: batch similar sites into waves, build and verify each on staging while the old site keeps serving, and move DNS only when the new copy passes a definition of done.
Done like this, the client's live site never goes dark, and migration becomes something you sell rather than dread.
